messages:
priya_csm: Hi team — kicking off Vellum Labs onboarding. Goal: have prod traffic on Redwood Hosted (with Dedicated option staged) by end of Q2. Proposed kickoff meeting: Thu 10/3 10:00am PT. Agenda: intros, success criteria, data/connectors, infra/setup, enablement/training, risks & next steps. Who can make that slot?

maya_cs: I can do Thu 10/3 10a. Will own onboarding checklist + enablement sessions.

liam_se: I can join. I’ll own SSO + data ingestion (S3 + direct upload). Need sample dataset and schema from Vellum.

jonas_eng: Available. I’ll take model access, Dedicated capacity sizing, and smoke tests. Can start infra prep this week.

alex_successops: Proposed success criteria (short):
- 95% of baseline requests under 250ms p50 on Hosted or Dedicated config
- End-to-end test suite passing for core flows
- SSO + data paths validated in staging
- Customer-run demo with stakeholders signed off
- Documented runbook + rollback plan

priya_csm: Adding renewal-risk watch: legal review for data retention may delay private deployment. Flagging as blocker if not done within 21 days. Also need CSM & Eng execs on the 30-day health check.

maya_cs: Quick timeline draft:
```
Week 0: Kickoff + discovery (this meeting)
Week 1-2: Access + infra setup (SSO, test data, staging model)
Week 3: Enablement sessions + integration run
Week 4: Pilot go/no-go demo + feedback capture
Week 5-8: Iteration & scale -> handoff to success ops
```

liam_se: @v ellum-team please share a sanitized sample (<=100MB) and a schema endpoint or JSON example. Prefer csv or ndjson.

jonas_eng: For Dedicated sizing I propose starting with 2xA100-equivalent perf for pilot. Will run benchmark and post numbers in the kickoff doc.

priya_csm: Action items from this thread:
- maya_cs: create onboarding checklist + invite (owner)
- liam_se: request sample data + SSO endpoints (owner)
- jonas_eng: bench initial Dedicated config + share template (owner)
- alex_successops: assemble success criteria + 30/60/90 template (owner)
- priya_csm: schedule recurring 2-week health check

maya_cs: I’ll create a shared kickoff doc and draft meeting invite by EOD.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Thu Oct 3 10:00am PT — "Vellum Labs: Redwood Onboarding Kickoff" — invites sent. Link: https://meet.redwood/example-link

liam_se: thumbs up :thumbsup: — I’ll drop preliminary SSO checklist in the doc.

alex_successops: Also proposing short feedback capture plan after pilot: 5-10 min user survey + 1:1 interview with primary PM. Will add to doc.

priya_csm: Great. If anyone has constraints on the timeline (legal, procurement), flag here now so we can re-prioritize. Otherwise I’ll send the calendar invite and kickoff doc link.

maya_cs: No blockers from my side. Looking forward.

liam_se: FYI infra team will need IP allowlist 48h before staging tests.

jonas_eng: Noted — will coordinate with infra.

priya_csm: Perfect — thanks all. See you Thu — agenda + pre-reads in the doc.
